### PROTOCOL: **Internal Draft: Protocol Aether-X-202**

## 1. Study Objectives
The primary objective is to evaluate the efficacy of Aether-X compared to placebo in reducing mean daily pain scores in patients with diabetic peripheral neuropathy.

## 2. Study Design
This is a randomized, double-blind, multicenter study. Subjects will be randomized 1:1 to receive either 50mg of Aether-X or a matching placebo.

## 3. Primary Efficacy Endpoint
The primary endpoint is the change from baseline to Week 12 in the Weekly Mean Pain Score (WMPS), derived from daily diaries using an 11-point Numerical Rating Scale (NRS).

## 4. Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP)
The primary analysis will utilize a Mixed Model for Repeated Measures (MMRM) to account for longitudinal data. The model is defined as:
$$Y_{ij} = \mu + \text{Visit}_j + \text{Trt}_i + (\text{Visit} \times \text{Trt})_{ij} + \epsilon_{ij}$$
where $Y_{ij}$ is the change from baseline NRS for subject $i$ at visit $j$.

## 5. Estimand and Intercurrent Events
The study will follow the ICH E9 R1 framework. An estimand is a precise description of the treatment effect reflecting the clinical question. We will account for intercurrent events such as treatment discontinuation and the use of rescue medication. We will use a "While-on-Treatment" strategy for these events to ensure the primary basis for determining substantial evidence is supported by well-controlled investigations.

## 6. Multiplicity
To control for the Type I error rate, procedures to control the rate will be pre-specified to ensure that the probability of making at least one Type I error does not exceed the desired level of significance (0.05).

## 7. Sample Size Calculation
The sample size is calculated to provide 80% power at a 5% significance level. We assume a treatment difference of $\delta = 1.5$ with a standard deviation of $\sigma = 2.5$.
$$N = \frac{2(Z_\alpha + Z_\beta)^2 \sigma^2}{\delta^2}$$
The final sample size will be adjusted for an anticipated dropout rate of 15%.
